cards.title: Cleansing Shrine
cards.hint: Interact to remove every curse from carried and equipped items.

cards.title: Offering bowl
cards.hint: Interact to read the inscription. Stand beside the bowl and drop five pieces of gear or sigils at its feet to receive a sigil.

cards.title: Portcullis lever
cards.hint: Pull to open the guarded equipment cache.

cards.title: Crypt funeral bell
cards.hint: Ring for an offering. Acolytes will answer.

cards.title: Resonating crystal
cards.hint: Touch to restore Mana and release an elemental mote. The sound attracts nearby enemies.

cards.title: Silk-wrapped survivor
cards.hint: Free the traveler for two special foods and a mapping sigil. Escort him to the upstairs for a ring or amulet. Beware the surrounding webs.

cards.title: Web curtain
cards.hint: Blocks the way. One blow cuts it; fire burns it away.
A blade is embedded in the moss-covered stone.
Browse the merchant stock. Purchases cost essence.
Someone is locked inside. Let them out and hope they are grateful.
Cut it down. Sometimes a heart is tucked underneath.

rule-break-loot.does: A breakable prop with lootPct is removed when hit (sound breakSfx, else crate-break); then lootPct% chance of loot: roll r; r<0.74: a further 50% chance of nothing, else essence round((4-10 + floor) x 1.5); r<0.78: one random food; else one random mote. "Something rolls out of the pieces."
rule-break-loot.ruling: 2026-10-14 loot pass: half as many essence piles, each 1.5x; no sigils from props

rule-dungeon-break.does: Dungeon floors 1-5 (not planes), Justin 2026-10-16 sandbox item 9: a weapon rack drops a weapon 10% of the time; otherwise a crate or rack rolls its lootPct, then crate: heart 30, globe 30, essence 30, slime 10; rack: heart, globe and essence evenly (the roll scaled to 0.9).

rule-bush.does: Bush: blocks, hit to cut; cut by fire leaves ash and no loot; otherwise 25% loot: 60% a heart, else essence 2-5 + floor ("A heart was tucked under the bush." / "Something glints among the cut leaves."). sfx step-grass at half volume. Regrows 150 actions later out of sight.

rule-fire.does: Burning tiles count down each action; a burnable prop on a tile whose fire runs out is removed (fluid barrels spill), grass/web/bare ground becomes ash (bare: scorch); each burning tile spreads to each orthogonal neighbour: tall grass 45%, short grass 18%, burnable prop 25%. A tile catches with grass 5 actions, otherwise 3; water never burns. Fire touching an explosive barrel blows it 250 ms later; web props and ice blocks are removed.

rule-mushroom-trample.does: A non-blocking mushroom, shroom or fungus prop is removed when a non-flying body steps on it and the tile gets short grass.

rule-gen-commit.does: After all builders: no prop on an object tile (chest, stairs, door, Forge); a prop never shares a tile with a trap (traps under props are dropped).

placement-dungeon-plain-room.biome: dungeon (also Crypt rooms, which then add their own crypt dressing)

inner.rule: flat pieces on shuffled interior cells; a blocking piece is skipped if its interior cell is beside a door, else it goes on a random edge cell instead

placement-vegetation.biome: dungeon and caverns (underdark has its own; crypt keeps its own ground cover; planes none)

overrides: start room: lush or overgrown becomes some
garden: lush (Dungeon gardens keep their own planting and are skipped)

placement-vegetation.moisture: max(water term, wall term) + noise patch + 0.1 if both terms > 0 + room damp; water term = 1 - 0.22 x (orthogonal steps to water or puddle, out to 4); wall term = 0.42 with 5+ wall neighbours (8-way), 0.34 with 3+, 0.22 with 1+; patch = (noise(x/3,y/3) - 0.5) x 0.55 + (noise(0.9x,0.9y) - 0.5) x 0.2
placement-vegetation.cells: free: plain floor, no ground (caverns: moss allowed), no prop, more than 1 from the player start; caverns: only cells of that cave room
growth: moisture >= tallAt: tall grass (caverns: only within 2 of water, else falls through)
else within 1 of water, or 2 with noise(0.8x,0.8y) > 0.4: short grass
plant spot when moisture >= spotAt and (a wall neighbour or overgrown) and hash < 18% caverns / 22% overgrown / 35% otherwise
placement-vegetation.corners: Dungeon, mood not bare: 1-3 random corner cells (wall on a vertical and a horizontal side); the corner 60% tall else short; each of the 8 neighbours 70% short; 50% a plant spot at the corner; skipped within 1 of the player
placement-vegetation.corridors: outside rooms, free, beside a wall: noise(x/2,y/2) > 0.72 and hash < 0.6: short grass
placement-vegetation.bushes: Dungeon only: each plant spot becomes a bush with 70% (lush) or 30% (other) if: plain floor, no prop, not within 1 of a door, stairs or chest, not in a gap (at most 2 open orthogonal neighbours), more than 2 from the player; then a row of 0-2 more bushes along the wall direction; a bush on tall grass turns it short
placement-vegetation.spots: one spot per tile; spots on props are dropped and grass under a spot is cleared; spots feed the art (bushes, ferns, flowers)
placement-vegetation.ruling: 2026-09-19 Justin: vegetation generous, in clusters, around water, never dotted at random; 2026-09-20 "mushrooms and other vegetation shouldn't spawn on top of the other vegetation"

rule-regrowth.bush: a cut bush is queued with due action = now + 150; from then it reappears the first action its tile is out of sight, empty (no creature, item, player), plain floor, no prop
rule-regrowth.grass: every 10th action: each tile that was grass at generation and is now short (from tall), ash, scorch or bare notes the action it changed; after 100 actions (trampled) or 200 (ash or scorch) and while out of sight and empty it grows back one step: ash/scorch/bare return as short grass first, then short returns to tall if it was tall
rule-regrowth.sets: regrowth runs where a vegetation set exists: Dungeon, Caverns, Crypt (mushroom set), Underdark, Earth plane
rule-regrowth.trample: the player or a non-flying creature stepping onto tall grass makes it short (player sound step-grass at 0.15 volume)
rule-regrowth.ruling: 2026-09-19 Justin: the food clock stops anyone farming it forever
